title: JSONEditor Options
description: Configuration options for the jsoneditor library by josdejong.

modes.description: Allowed modes shown in the mode switcher menu.

schema.description: A JSON schema used to validate the JSON data.

schemaRefs.description: Schemas referenced via $ref from the main schema.

name.description: Initial field name for the root node.

search.description: Show a search box in the upper right corner.

history.description: Enable undo/redo buttons (tree, form, preview modes).

indentation.description: Number of spaces used for indentation.

escapeUnicode.description: Escape unicode characters as hexadecimal codes.

sortObjectKeys.description: Sort object keys in tree, view, or form modes.

onChange.description: Callback fired when the user changes the JSON content.

onEditable.description: Callback to determine whether a node is editable (tree mode).

onError.description: Callback fired when an error occurs.

onModeChange.description: Callback fired when the mode is changed. Signature: (newMode, oldMode).

onCreateMenu.description: Callback to customize the context menu (tree mode). Signature: (items, node).

ace.description: A custom instance of the Ace editor for code mode.

ajv.description: A custom instance of ajv for JSON schema validation.

theme.description: Ace editor theme used in code mode.
